description: Index of t.ROY / coach doctrine skills. THIS FILE IS THE SOURCE OF TRUTH for what skills exist and when they load. Adding a skill = add an entry here + a folder `<id>/SKILL.md` (optionally with companion data: facts.json, scripts, examples). No code change needed -- lib/skills-loader.ts reads this. Activation: a skill loads when the current page is in `pages` (any user), or in `pagesIfCriminalRecord` when the user disclosed a record, or when `always` is true.
